findings.title: Member routes bind :id, but the controller and spec read :group_id
findings.body: `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` and `put "members" => "groups#add_members"` sit directly inside `resources :groups` without `collection do`, so they generate `/admin/groups/:id/members`. `Admin::GroupsController#add_members` and `#remove_member` read `params.require(:group_id)`, which is never supplied on that path, so every real call raises ParameterMissing (400/500). The frontend `Discourse.Group#addMembers`/`removeMember` call `/admin/groups/{id}/members.json`, so the feature is broken end to end. The controller spec passes `group_id:` directly, which masks the mismatch.

findings.title: remove_member and add_members read group_id but the route supplies id
findings.body: `Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i)` in `remove_member` (and the same pattern in `add_members`) requires a `group_id` parameter, but the only route that reaches these actions uses `:id` as the path segment. Requests from the admin UI therefore fail before any membership change happens.

findings.title: totalPages is off by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit
findings.body: `totalPages` computes `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. With 100 users and limit 50 this yields 3 pages instead of 2. `showingLast` is then false on the real last page, so `next` sets offset to min(offset+limit, user_count) = 100 and loads an empty page. The same formula is used in `currentPage`'s counterpart, so the pager shows a phantom page.

findings.title: members endpoint accepts unbounded or negative limit/offset
findings.body: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` has no upper bound, so any visible group can be dumped in one request, which the previous automatic-only cap was meant to prevent for large groups. A negative `limit` or `offset` is passed straight into SQL LIMIT/OFFSET, which PostgreSQL rejects, producing a 500. Clamp limit to a sane maximum and floor both values at 0.

findings.title: findMembers returns undefined for empty names and callers ignore the promise
findings.body: `findMembers` returns nothing when `name` is empty, while the rest of the method returns a promise. Callers such as `admin_group_route.js` `setupController` and `group-members.js.es6` call `model.findMembers()` without handling the result, so errors from the AJAX request are unhandled and the loading state is never observable.

findings.title: Stale selector targets a removed element id
findings.body: `.row.groups input#group-users { width: 600px; }` still references the `group-users` id, which this PR removed from `group.hbs` (the user selector now uses `id="user-selector"`). The rule is dead and the intended width for the member input is no longer applied.

findings.title: Specs pass parameters that do not match the real routes and HTTP verbs
findings.body: The spec calls `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42` although the only remove route is DELETE, and it uses `group_id` where the route provides `:id`. Controller specs do not check routing, so these tests pass while the actual endpoints are broken. There is also no test for the groups#members pagination (limit/offset/meta), which is the other main behavior change.

findings.title: Unfinished TODO left in addMembers
findings.body: The `// TODO: should clear the input` comment marks a known UI bug: after adding members the username selector keeps its previous value, so a repeated click re-submits the same usernames. The defect is shipped rather than fixed.

findings.title: removeMember and addMembers have no error handling
findings.body: Both methods return an AJAX promise that only reloads members on success. A failed request (e.g. 422 for automatic groups) is not surfaced to the user, and the admin controller's `removeMember` action does not handle the rejection, so the UI silently does nothing.

findings.title: PR description is a placeholder
findings.body: The description reads only "Test 8", so reviewers have no statement of the intent, the removed update/PATCH API, or the new member pagination contract (meta.total/limit/offset). The API change needs documenting.
